core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Cyberpunk with Minimalist Utility
Emotion First: The user should feel 'In the Zone'
Content is King: The typing text is the hero
Negative Space: Use deep void backgrounds to make neon pop
Contrast: High contrast text for readability, subtle glows for atmosphere

layout_strategy.home_page: Use a centralized Grid layout. Remove all <table> tags. Create a Hero section with the title and a grid of 'Mode Cards' for 1min, 2min, etc.
layout_strategy.typing_page: Center the typing container (wrapper) using Flexbox (min-h-screen, justify-center, align-center). Use the 'Glassmorphism' style for the wrapper.

buttons.base: padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Outfit'; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
buttons.primary: background: transparent; border: 1px solid #00f3ff; color: #00f3ff; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.1);
buttons.hover: transform: scale(1.05); background: rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.1); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.4); text-shadow: 0 0 8px #00f3ff;

cards.hover_effect: transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.02); border-color: #bc13fe; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(188, 19, 254, 0.2);

animations.float: @keyframes float { 0% { transform: translateY(0px); } 50% { transform: translateY(-10px); } 100% { transform: translateY(0px); } }
animations.pulse_glow: @keyframes pulseGlow { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.2); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.6); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.2); } }

universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text contrast ratios are met. Use 'aria-label' on icon buttons. Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-button', data-testid='typing-input').

implementation_steps: 1. Remove all legacy HTML table layouts.
2. Create a 'style.css' or update 'index.css'/'typingtest.css' with the new Design System variables and classes.
3. Apply the Google Fonts to the body.
4. Refactor the Home Page to use a CSS Grid layout for the mode selection cards.
5. Refactor the Typing Page to use a Flexbox centered layout with the Glassmorphism wrapper.
7. Add the background image with an overlay to ensure text readability.
8. Ensure all 'a' tags look like interactive buttons or cards, not just blue text.
